content.name: Émilie Bouchard
content.title: French Immersion Teacher, Grade 5
content.summary: OCT-certified French Immersion teacher with nine years in Ottawa elementary schools, from occasional teaching to a permanent Grade 5 classroom. I hold Additional Qualifications in French as a Second Language and Special Education, and 21 of my 26 students finished last year reading at or above grade level on GB+ French reading assessments.

experience.title: Occasional Teacher
experience.company: Ottawa Valley Lakes District School Board
bullets: Covered daily and short-term absences in K–8 classrooms across 14 schools, in both English and French Immersion programs.
Kept detailed day plans and notes for returning teachers and was requested back by 9 schools.
Built a portable kit of French phonics games used to keep immersion lessons on track during supply days.

experience.title: Long-Term Occasional Teacher, Grade 3 French Immersion
experience.company: Ottawa Valley Lakes District School Board
bullets: Taught a Grade 3 French Immersion class of 24 for a full school year, including report cards and parent conferences.
Introduced daily guided reading groups in French, moving 15 of 24 students up at least two reading levels.
Co-planned science units with an English partner teacher so students received consistent vocabulary in both languages.

experience.title: French Immersion Teacher, Grade 5
experience.company: Ottawa Valley Lakes District School Board
bullets: Teach French language, math, science and social studies in French to a Grade 5 class of 26, with 4 students on IEPs.
Raised the number of students reading at or above grade level on GB+ French reading assessments from 14 to 21 over the 2024–25 year.
Led the transition to remote learning on Google Classroom for my grade team, delivering 5 hours of live lessons a day in 2020–21.
Run the school's Franco-Ontarian Day celebrations and a lunchtime theatre club of 20 students.
Mentor teacher candidates from the University of Ottawa on their practicum, supervising 4 candidates since 2021.

education.details: Two-year consecutive program taught in French.

achievements.title: Ontario College of Teachers (OCT)
